sn3.17:1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn3.17:1.4: atthi nu kho bhante eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati,
sn3.17:2.1: atthi kho mahārāja eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati,
sn3.17:3.1: katamo pana bhante eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati,
sn3.17:4.1: appamādo kho mahārāja eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati
sn3.17:4.3: seyyathāpi mahārāja yāni kānici jaṅgamānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ mahantattena.
sn3.17:4.4: evameva kho mahārāja appamādo eko dhammo yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati
